curatorReviewQueue.evidence: Originally PSVR-required at launch; a free May 2018 Gold Edition update added a non-VR Classic Mode for all existing owners. Dossier written reflecting current playable-without-VR state, but flagging for curator awareness since the underlying census rule concerns PSVR requirement and this is a patched-not-originally-optional case (same category as The Persistence, previously reviewed and KEPT).

Pearl Abyss ended all PS4 server support on June 26, 2025 (confirmed via PlayStation.Blog/PSU/official Pearl Abyss notice). The game can no longer be downloaded or played on PS4 in any form; PS4 owners were offered a free upgrade to the PS5 version. The physical PS4 disc no longer represents a functioning game. Dossier written factually noting this; census status NOT changed pending curator decision on whether a server-dead online-only game still qualifies as a meaningfully playable physical PS4 identity.

Ubisoft permanently shut down all servers and delisted the game on March 31, 2024, revoking licenses. Always-online with no offline mode -- the entire game, including single-player, is now unplayable on any platform for any owner, physical disc included. More severe than a single-platform sunset. Census status NOT changed pending curator decision.

Same underlying game/shutdown as The Crew (id 1231) -- this expansion-inclusive edition is equally completely unplayable since the March 2024 permanent server shutdown. Census status NOT changed pending curator decision.
